messages:
maya: FYI seeing a weird reconnect spike from APAC clients behind proxy-apac-1. Pattern: SSE heartbeats (":

  id: hb
  data: ping

) are being coalesced/compressed by the CDN, so downstream never sees the newline delim that our client heartbeat parser expects => clients think stream dead and reconnect. Numbers: +40% reconnects for mobile region.

rene: That explains the 204/no-body responses we saw earlier — proxy coalescing tiny idle frames. Do we have raw headers or sample frames?

maya: Sample: 
```
client -> GET /stream
proxy -> 200 OK (Transfer-Encoding: chunked)
proxy (after coalesce) -> chunk: "id:hb
data:ping

id:hb
data:ping

"
client parser expects heartbeat boundary after every 

 but coalesce makes it look like one big chunk -> parser ignores until final newline -> perceived slowness
```

rene: Short-term mitigation: relax client heartbeat timeout to 10s for APAC mobile user-agents, and emit telemetry stream.heartbeat.coalesce. Medium: have proxy preserve event delimiters (i.e., don't buffer tiny SSE chunks).

maya: I'll start a canary with client-side timeout bump for apac-mobile UA. Also add metric stream.heartbeat.coalesce and dashboard tile.

ops-bot: Deployment queued: maya/client-heartbeat-relax -> canary apac-1

rene: Also add server-side guard: if we detect multiple hb events coalesced in same chunk, split on server before forwarding to client (cheap transform). Could land quick in edge proxy.

maya: Good idea. I'll file a small proxy patch ticket and an RFC for SSE framing guarantees. Console note: session counts currently spike because clients reconnect quickly. Console filter for "hide transient reconnects" would help product dashboards.

console-bot: Created ticket CONS-2099 to add transient reconnect filter and a checkbox on the Sessions dashboard.

maya: Canary (5m): reconnect spike reduced ~60% on canary clients. stream.heartbeat.coalesce metric fired on apac-1. No CPU/mem impact.

rene: Follow-ups: (1) proxy patch to preserve SSE framing (PR by Rene) (2) console filter CONS-2099 (3) add alert: stream.heartbeat.coalesce > 10/min for region -> ops page.

maya: Promoting to rolling after 20m stable. Closing thread after full rollout.
